notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures that are valid targets for Elvish Fury.
description:
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Zada.
Zada and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zada trigger, copying Elvish Fury for each creature you control.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Elvish Fury copies, giving all other creatures you control +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Zada +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G}.
Repeat.
